53b3677e.text:
This is a deed to an expanse of land within the region of Westfall.  It entitles the persons below with ownership rights of the designated area, as well as all items produced and any structures built within its borders.

The document is signed by:

    Theodore Furlbrow
    Verna Furlbrow
53b3677e.title: Furlbrow's Deed

10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11096|ddec75b2.name: Randal Worth
11096|ddec75b2.text: I already know a lot about style. Now it's just a matter of mastering the techniques for working with leather. Good thing Simon's a real sport about helping me learn them.

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1244|e492be56.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|e492be56.text:
<Rethiel takes the Rotheap Innards from you.>

It is worse than I thought. The dark presence deep beneath us seethes with a malevolence that has seeped into the very fibers of life within the wetlands.

For now, I fear all we can do is combat its symptoms. Provide relief to the land and those who rely on it where we can.

Meanwhile, we must continue to look for the source. It roils... whispers just under the veil of the sounds of night.

Take this, as a token of my gratitude. May it help you further combat this madness.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1295|ed056522.name: Lara Moore
1295|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1319|877c4b1d.name: Bryan Cross
1319|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1333|877c4b1d.name: Gerik Koen
1333|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

14725|372d0086.name: Raedon Duskstriker
14725|372d0086.text:
Hail friend - a moment of your time, if I may...

We have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing Teldrassil.  Were the constant strife of the times not enough, we now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of night elves everywhere in helping us out!

14981|b475c580.name: Elfarran
14981|b475c580.text: Hail to thee $N.  Do you wish me to aid you in your journey to Warsong Gulch?

15008|e2727850.name: Lady Hoteshem
15008|e2727850.text: I've been expecting you $N.  Are you ready to assist us in Arathi Basin?

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

263349|53fff4bc.name: James Battlewing
263349|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

263644|53fff4bc.name: Pherry Leftee
263644|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268047|c401ba80.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|c401ba80.text: $N, the Stormpike Guard is in need of your aid in the battle against the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley, now more than ever.  The opportunities for honor and repute are greater than ever as well! Will you join the battle?

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

274757|cd082f2e.name: Temple Highguard
274757|cd082f2e.text: I received the majority of my weapons training from Ilyenia Moonfire in the $C's Terrace.  You would do well to seek her out if you desire to learn the use of a new weapon.

274757|ce424d00.name: Temple Highguard
274757|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

274781|ab5dd850.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

274781|ac68ec99.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ac68ec99.text: Yer looking to learn how to use a new weapon are ye?  Well, ye should be talking to Bixi or Buliwyf over at the Timberline Arms weapon shop then lad.  They know their weapons from axes to... uh... zweihanders.

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

277024|1226420e.name: Jelinek Sharpshear
277024|1226420e.text:
Welcome to my barbershop! We offer cuts, colorings, and more.

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink night elf tattoos, anything you might need.

Have a seat and we'll get to work.

2913|5112b624.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|5112b624.text: Who would have guessed the excavation would have uncovered such findings!

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3516|cc6cb2bd.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
3516|cc6cb2bd.text: Make it quick, $c. Observing and guiding the growth of Teldrassil leaves me with little time to waste to idle banter.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3567|0cdab46e.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|0cdab46e.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that warriors like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3598|1c27b384.name: Kyra Windblade
3598|1c27b384.text: Greetings.  Do you seek instruction in art of war?

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3691|3e6c050b.name: Raene Wolfrunner
3691|3e6c050b.text: I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

3692|6e5dc9aa.name: Volcor
3692|6e5dc9aa.text:
Well, the way I see it, $N, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.

We can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.

I'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.

3692|966370fe.name: Volcor
3692|966370fe.text:
<Volcor doesn't look at you at all as you get close to him. He seems to be concentrating on keeping his bandages from falling off. After a moment, he looks up at you, a little startled.>

Oh, sorry, $c. Now's not a good time. I hope you understand.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4087|1c27b384.name: Arias'ta Bladesinger
4087|1c27b384.text: Greetings.  Do you seek instruction in art of war?

4088|9170b739.name: Elanaria
4088|9170b739.text: A $c's path is one of determination, brother.  It may begin with strength of arms, but it endures through force of will.

4155|c7fcb1fe.name: Idriana
4155|c7fcb1fe.text: Welcome to the Bank of Darnassus. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

4156|c2467ddc.name: Astaia
4156|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

4241|b0e0696e.name: Mydrannul
4241|b0e0696e.text: It is my honor to provide for adventurers, for they are heroes in the making.

4262|0ff252d7.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|0ff252d7.text: You may find storage for your worldly goods at the bank of Darnassus, which lies in the center of our wondrous city.

4262|84b403e6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|84b403e6.text: Astaia has fished up some curious treasures over the ages she has spent fishing.  Why don't you go see her over in the Tradesman's terrace and have her show you some of them.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

4262|e66389a6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e66389a6.text: One has opened up on the Tradesman's Terrace.  If you take the path leading Southeast from the bank, it should be easy to find.

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5514|211be282.name: Brooke Stonebraid
5514|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5595|5ba67714.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|5ba67714.text: Aye, and which battleground be ye looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6736|41276936.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

7315|4bb9e8d2.name: Darnath Bladesinger
7315|4bb9e8d2.text: Greetings.  You seek instruction in the art of war?

7999|3d397bbf.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|3d397bbf.text: Greetings, $c. I am Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess of Elune.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1442-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
1442-accept.text:
Greetings, $N. What can I do for one who follows a holy path?

Ah, yes, Stilwell, the blacksmith... from long ago. I remember him well, though, I have not heard his name in some time.

He never struck me as an impudent man, so I can only assume his desire for a Kor gem is noble.

If you truly wish for one of the gems, then you must head to the northwest of Ashenvale. You will find Blackfathom Deeps there within some ancient ruins. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, $c.
1442-accept.title: Seeking the Kor Gem

1655-accept.name: Bailor Stonehand
1655-accept.text:
Ach, ya startled me, man! Can't ya see I was lost in thought?

What's that? Jordan's shipment... fer Ironforge. Ahhh, yeah, I know whatcha speak of. Mo'grosh ogres... dat's who took me ol' friend's ore shipment. Caravan was headin' here from the Wetlands and was ambushed. The guard who survived their attack just passed away a few days ago--healer couldn't get to 'em fast enough.

If you want the shipment, you'll have to head northeast across the Loch. It's got to be there somewhere.
1655-accept.title: Bailor's Ore Shipment

1655-complete.name: Bailor Stonehand
1655-complete.text:
Yup yup, this is it. Ha! If I'd known you were really gonna head out there and fight some o' them ogres, I woulda given you a list of things to get instead of just this one thing. But, you're not here doin' business for me, are ya?.

A deal's a deal; Jordan wanted a shipment of me alloy, that's what he's gonna get.

Tell 'em hello fer me, and be safe, $c.
1655-complete.title: Bailor's Ore Shipment

1655-progress.name: Bailor Stonehand
1655-progress.text: So, any luck yet? Haha, those ogres didn't get the best of ya yet, did they?
1655-progress.title: Bailor's Ore Shipment

490-accept.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-accept.text:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.
490-accept.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-complete.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-complete.text: You have served well, $N. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
490-complete.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

7792-progress.name: Raedon Duskstriker
7792-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Darnassus for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7792-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

86614-accept.name: Unknown
86614-accept.text: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614-accept.title: Silver of the Waves

91736-progress.name: Unknown
91736-progress.text: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
91736-progress.title: Applejack Still

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

97894-complete.name: Gorbold Steelhand
97894-complete.text:
Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894-complete.title: Business in Auberdine

97948-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97948-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97948-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97948-complete.name: Kurdram Stonehammer
97948-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97948-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining

98013-accept.name: Arbal
98013-accept.text:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, $c. War... is what we will bring.
98013-accept.title: Swelling Forces

98013-complete.name: Arbal
98013-complete.text:
Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...

It is unforgivable.
98013-complete.title: Swelling Forces

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98028-accept.name: Unknown
98028-accept.text:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028-accept.title: Baron Marinous

98028-complete.name: Onu
98028-complete.text:
<Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>

Stairs descending in Mathystra? Could it be?

<Onu shakes his head.>

I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.
98028-complete.title: Baron Marinous

98028-progress.name: Onu
98028-progress.text: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, $r... what have you brought me?
98028-progress.title: Baron Marinous

98042-accept.name: Danstar
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-complete.text:
<Thundris does not speak for some time.>

This bears the mark of an ancient evil, $c. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.

Ande'thoras-ethil.
98042-complete.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98067-accept.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-accept.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067-accept.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98067-complete.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-complete.text: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
98067-complete.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98392-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-accept.text:
These belts... look closely at the leather, $N. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392-accept.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-complete.text:
<Arynia investigates the amulets.>

Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.

I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.

I will inform my superiors of this at once.
98392-complete.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade
